goal: Agent memory privacy review: personal and secret data kept out of what the agent remembers.
use: Agent memory privacy review: personal and secret data kept out of what the agent remembers. Use when an agent stores anything a user or a tool provides.

steps.note: List what can enter memory. User messages, tool results and files.
Flag personal data. Names, contact details, identifiers and health or financial details.
Flag secrets. Keys, tokens and passwords that a tool may return.
Check the filter. Confirm something removes these before they are stored.
Report. Each entry path, what it can store, and the filter that is missing.
